name: activity
description: Live activity: turn time + tool count in a band, per-tool and subagent detail (status, elapsed, turns, tokens) in a pane, and a native notification when a long turn ends or Claude asks a question.

workItemsUrl.title: Work items base URL
workItemsUrl.description: Azure DevOps work-items base URL; the band's WI link points here (e.g. https://org.visualstudio.com/PROJECT/_workitems/edit). Leave blank to hide the link.

extraRageWords.title: Extra rage words
extraRageWords.description: Comma/space separated words appended to the built-in rage-meter list (whole-word, case-insensitive). The 🤬 counter adds 1 per message that trips any built-in OR custom word, or that is written mostly in UPPERCASE.
